# PANDA Terminal

## What this site is
PANDA Terminal is execution-first crypto trading infrastructure focused on decentralized markets.
The platform combines cross-venue order execution, portfolio risk tooling, and embedded market intelligence.

## Key pages
- Home: https://pandaterminal.com/
- Announcement: https://pandaterminal.com/announcement
- Terms of Service: https://pandaterminal.com/termsofservice
- Privacy Policy: https://pandaterminal.com/privacy-policy

## Product snapshot
- One wallet, multiple venues (DEXes, perps, options)
- Decentralized-first execution workflows
- Institutional-grade risk and operations tooling
- Integrated analytics at point of execution

## Primary audience
Professional and advanced crypto traders, trading teams, and execution-focused market participants.

## Primary intent
Learn about PANDA Terminal 2.0 and join the early access community.
